lane_declared_by_session: Completeness-weighted PU (spatially-varying Elkan-Noto label frequency); OLC91's pre-ranked but never-run H2, with the hole-shuffled control OLC91 required
hypothesis: H1 CWP: weighting a PU-HGB fault posterior by (1 - chat), where chat is a 1 km spatial catalogue-completeness field (smoothed visible-catalogue density / smoothed Elkan-calibrated expected fault density), improves recovery of withheld faults vs the identical posterior alone AND vs a hole-shuffled control, at identical 37,654-dot emission.
mechanism: PU theory with spatially varying label frequency c(x)=P(labelled|fault,x): P(unlabelled fault|x) is proportional to p_y(x)(1-c(x)). Where mapping is already dense relative to predicted fault density (chat->1) a high posterior is most likely an already-mapped fault; where the catalogue is sparser than the geology predicts (chat->0) the same posterior is a discovery candidate. Encodes the independently reported live depletion of new faults near mapped faults.
named_non_fault_mimic: A mapping-effort gradient (edge of a detailed 1:24k quadrangle map or land-ownership boundary where field mapping stopped): chat drops because nobody mapped there, not because faults are present-but-unmapped; CWP would promote ordinary lineaments along the survey boundary. Secondary: young alluvial/playa cover where the expected-density denominator is itself depressed.

instrument.split: vendor gems57 buffered_component_draw(seed=20, hide_frac=0.20, buffer_px=3, boundary_px=12)
instrument.training: leave-one-quadrant-out HGB, PU (hidden components unlabelled), 40 px train buffer
instrument.transform: E1: p*(1-chat), chat=clip(G10*visible_cat / G10*clip(p/c_bar,0,1),0,1); CTL: same with catalogue shifted (+173,-211) px
instrument.emission: submodular_dti_emit, budget 37654 x area share, collar > 2.0 px from known
instrument.metric: pooled DTI, alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 300 m triangular kernel; paired 20 km-block bootstrap, 1000 draws

holdout.comparability: Same instrument/recipe/seed as OLC91: E0 re-measured here at 0.085260 HOLDOUT-DTI, byte-for-byte the OLC91 E0 value on this evaluator (per-fold identical), so deltas are attributable to the surface transform only. Not comparable with gems91-hide-recover-v1.0 numbers (e.g. S14-PTAC 0.267782) and not a leaderboard projection.

cwp_chat.note: chat is POSITIVELY associated with withheld truth on this instrument (hidden components sit in mapped neighbourhoods within the 1 km smoothing scale); this explains the negative result mechanistically. Below the 0.90 leakage threshold: PASS, reported not hidden.
